name: gstin-validator
description: Validate an Indian GSTIN. Use when a user pastes a GSTIN or checks an invoice.

name: gst-invoice
description: Build a GST tax invoice with CGST, SGST or UTGST, IGST, and export endorsements. Use when creating an invoice, credit note, or export or SEZ bill.

name: gst-e-invoice-json
description: Build and validate GST e-invoice JSON (schema 1.1) without calling an IRP. Use when a user needs an IRN payload or a schema check.

name: freelancer-export-compliance
description: Financial year, LUT, GST realisation, and FEMA deadlines for an export of services. Use when a freelancer invoices a foreign or SEZ client.

name: tds-freelancer-payments
description: TDS on contractor and professional payments under the Income-tax Act 2025. Use when computing a deduction, a threshold, or the no-PAN rate.

name: razorpay-integration
description: Verify Razorpay payment signatures and webhooks, and convert amounts to subunits. Use when adding Razorpay checkout or a webhook.

name: cashfree-integration
description: Verify Cashfree webhook signatures and reject stale timestamps. Use when adding a Cashfree webhook.

name: upi-payment-links
description: Build unsigned UPI payment links and QR SVGs. Use when a user asks for a UPI link or QR. A link is not proof of payment.

name: inr-formatting
description: Format rupees in Indian grouping and in words. Use when showing an amount or an amount-in-words line.

name: indian-id-validators
description: Format-check PAN, TAN, IFSC, PIN, and Indian mobile numbers. Use when a user pastes one of those IDs. An IFSC directory lookup is opt-in.

name: aadhaar-safe-handling
description: Verhoeff-check, mask, and scan for Aadhaar numbers. Use when text may contain an Aadhaar. Never log a full number.

name: dpdp-compliance-check
description: Scan a schema for personal data and list DPDP Act and Rules dates. Use when reviewing a schema or a privacy checklist.

name: sms-otp-dlt
description: Lint DLT SMS templates and OTP handling. Use when writing an OTP SMS or a DLT template.
